findings.text: Doc Maintenance violation introduced by this PR. README:11 and README:284 still state completion is push-based because the worker 'sends a summary line to the orchestrator pane via tmux send-keys'. US-003 deleted that worker self-push; the worker now only writes scripts/cam/worker-report.json and the sidecar (notifyOrchestrator) emits the [cam] narration. README:163/254/284 also still describe cam next as a send-keys slash-command injector, contradicting US-001 (cam next is now a pure active:true flip) and the already-fixed cam-next.md command doc (US-R1-001). Sync the README cam-next/worker-exit prose to the shipped single-pusher behavior.

The try/catch around the active:true write swallows fs errors and the code then unconditionally emitOk()s success and returns 0. After US-001 this write is the SOLE effect of the hit path, so a silent write failure yields a false success and the sidecar never triggers. The catch comment 'the sidecar will still pick up the next active flag write' is now false (there is no other write; this IS it). Consider surfacing a non-zero exit + clear error on write failure and correcting the stale comment.

Terminal-blocked notify sites narrate the worker's self-reported outcome from worker-report.json (e.g. DONE), which can contradict the supervisor's block decision, so the orchestrator pane may show '[cam] US-XXX DONE' on a story the supervisor actually blocked. Spec-conformant (PRD lists terminal-blocked as a notify case) and matches the prior worker self-push, so non-blocking.
